title: Gujarat
tagline: Temple towns, lions and the white desert
description: Gujarat folds faith, history and wilderness into a single journey. Pray at the sacred shrines of Dwarka and Somnath on the Arabian Sea, walk through Mahatma Gandhi's birthplace in Porbandar and his ashram on the Sabarmati, and step back 4,500 years at the Harappan port of Lothal.

Inland, Sasan Gir is the last home of the Asiatic lion, while the palaces of Gondal and Rajkot, the stepwells around Ahmedabad and the endless white salt flats of the Rann of Kutch show a state rich in craft, colour and quiet grandeur.

highlights.title: Dwarka & Somnath
highlights.text: Two of India's holiest shrines on the Saurashtra coast — Dwarkadhish Temple and the first of the twelve Jyotirlingas.

highlights.title: Lions of Sasan Gir
highlights.text: Jeep safaris through the only wild home of the Asiatic lion, alongside leopards, deer and over 300 bird species.

highlights.title: Footsteps of Gandhi
highlights.text: Kirti Mandir in Porbandar, where the Mahatma was born, and the serene Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad.

highlights.title: The white Rann of Kutch
highlights.text: A shimmering salt desert that stretches to the horizon — magical under a full moon during the Rann Utsav.

quickFacts.bestTime: October – March (Gir closed mid-June to mid-October)
